description: This file defines a Java interface named SalesManagerEntityService which specifies service operations for managing entities in a system, including create, update, delete, fetch, and list functionalities. It uses generics to handle different entity types and includes exception handling.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an entity to the database; may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing entity in the database; may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity in the database; may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an entity from the database; may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of the entity from the database.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its identifier.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all entities of this type.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity based on class type and identifier.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of entities of this type in the database.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the session to commit changes.
